integrity: A finite exact permutation and simplicial-collapse program, its complete 56-class certificate, and its recorded output are supplied; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is only for the six-point complete-graph matching complex and all its natural S6-subgroup fixed spaces; it does not cover larger graphs, normalizer actions, geometric quotients, or the full equivariant homotopy type. Priority remains subject to unindexed results and incomplete access to the original 1992 Bouc and 2003 Wachs survey.
title: Fixed-point rigidity of the six-point matching complex
